risks.risk: Console model/size (PS4 vs PS4 Pro vs PS4 Slim) and exact identity are unknown from the photo, which affects market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/model number (or the back/side sticker) and the full console in frame.

risks.risk: Controllers/pads may be non-original, missing, or faulty (seller claims 2 pads).
risks.proof: Photos of both controllers (front + back), showing model/brand markings, plus a short video of them pairing and working in-game/menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if controllers are missing or not guaranteed working (worst-case).

risks.risk: Games count/condition may differ (seller claims 7 games).
risks.proof: A photo showing all game discs/cases laid out with titles visible (or a video panning across all 7).
risks.if_unproven: Price as fewer games or unknown condition (worst-case).

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (seller says complete accessories).
risks.proof: Photo of every accessory laid out: power cable, HDMI, USB/cables, headset/stand if any—everything listed.

risks.risk: Functionality claims (ports working, no overheating) may be false or untested.
risks.proof: Short test video: console boots to home screen, controller works, HDMI/USB ports tested, and a 10–15 minute gameplay/benchmark showing stable operation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potential faults (worst-case).

risks.risk: Receipt authenticity and ownership proof are not shown; could be missing or not matching the console.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the UK receipt with item details visible (date, model/serial if present).

proof_requests: Photo of the full PS4 console (front and back) plus a close-up of the model/serial label.
Photos of both controllers (front + back) showing markings, and a short pairing/inputs test video.
Photo/video showing all 7 games clearly (titles visible) and whether discs are included.
Photo of all accessories laid out (power, HDMI, cables, any extras) to confirm completeness.
Short functionality test video: boot to home screen, ports tested, and a brief gameplay/benchmark to check overheating.
response.reason: The provided photo only shows game cases; the PS4 console, controllers, accessories, and receipt are not visible, so the item identity and condition cannot be verified remotely. Without proof, any price would be guesswork.
